description: Every time someone updates Karvey, the first session in a Karvey project asks once (per clone) whether they want a project upgrade plan; a deterministic plan computed from the project's state is shown dry-run first and only the steps the person picks are applied, on a branch, through one PR.
goal: No project stays silently behind the installed method: every update ends in an offer, and every accepted step is applied reproducibly and reviewably.
security_tier_reason: a session hook writes clone-local state and a script rewrites project files (spec.json, project.json, hook copies); values read from the project reach shell commands

skipped.infra: no cloud; CI is the existing lint workflow
